gloss_en: Large Revit/BIM models are extremely laggy in the browser; exporting to FBX/GLB works but does not scale, so a dedicated lightweight engine was bought.
title_original: 大型 BIM 模型在 Web 端为什么这么卡？一次引擎选型与技术复盘
question_paraphrase: 模型能导出、能加载、能显示，不等于能在浏览器里高效跑；解析阻塞主线程、draw call 太多、拾取/隐藏/属性查询变慢，合并几何又丢构件语义
context_given: 在线部署后体验与本地不一致
phrasing_notes: engineering retrospective; lists pain points in bullet style; mixes English terms (draw call, LOD, GLB)
answer_summary: Generic web 3D engines do not scale; use a BIM-specific lightweighting pipeline that keeps component identity, chunks data and avoids main-thread blocking.

gloss_en: End-to-end pipeline Revit IFC -> glTF + metadata.json for a Three.js 3D dashboard; lists pitfalls: lost expressID, grey materials, mm vs m scale x1000, origin offset, slow raycasting at 20k elements.
title_original: AI 驱动三维大屏的端到端工程化：从 Revit/IFC 到 Three.js 的落地实践
question_paraphrase: IfcConvert 会合并构件、丢 expressID，要额外写入 GlobalId 才能和属性表关联；材质全变灰；毫米和米单位导致放大1000倍；IFC原点和项目基点不一致
phrasing_notes: practice-report voice, numbered layers, English tool names inline, concrete numbers (200MB to 5MB)
answer_summary: Convert geometry with IfcConvert/web-ifc, extract properties with web-ifc into metadata.json keyed by GlobalId, split by storey, add LOD and BVH picking, build explicit material map and handle unit/origin offsets.

gloss_en: Converting Revit IFC to DAE with IfcConvert and then to glTF with COLLADA2GLTF to view in xeogl; suspects Chinese characters in the path break the command.
title_original: 将IFC转换成GLTF格式
question_paraphrase: 先用IfcConvert把ifc转成dae，再用COLLADA2GLTF转gltf，在xeogl里打开；路径里有中文好像会失败，所以进工具目录里执行
phrasing_notes: step-by-step learner note; casual caveat about Chinese path
answer_summary: Two-step conversion IFC->DAE->glTF via command line; keep paths ASCII-only.

gloss_en: Surveys how to make Revit models light enough for web/Unity: FBX, IFC, OBJ, glTF; materials turn grey in Unity, >100MB freezes, WebGL runs out of memory, xeokit licence is paid.
title_original: BIM轻量化之路（一）
question_paraphrase: 模型导进Unity后管道材质变灰；超过100M的模型就卡死；WebGL三角面多了内存爆；BIMserver的viewer功能太少，xeokit要收费，xeogl文档又少
phrasing_notes: technical diary, first person, lists problems as bullets
answer_summary: Use Revit API IExportContext to export geometry plus properties into a component tree by level; use Unity for presentation, WebGL for management platforms.

gloss_en: Load an IFC model in the browser with xBIM WebUI: set up ASP.NET project, MIME type for .wexbim, convert IFC to wexbim via IfcStore + Xbim3DModelContext.
title_original: xBIM 实战01 在浏览器中加载IFC模型文件
question_paraphrase: 要在网页里看IFC，得先用IfcStore打开，Xbim3DModelContext生成几何，SaveAsWexBim；web.config要加.wexbim的MIME，请求大小调到100MB
phrasing_notes: tutorial series style (实战01), code-heavy, imperative steps
answer_summary: Convert IFC to .wexbim server-side and serve with application/octet-stream; viewer loads only wexbim.

gloss_en: Modify an IfcBeam's name and add a property set by looking it up via GlobalId in Java and writing a new IFC file.
title_original: 修改IFC对象属性并写入IFC文件
question_paraphrase: 读入IFC文件，按GlobalID找到梁，改名字，加属性集，再写出新文件
answer_summary: Read model, find by GlobalId, set attribute, add IfcPropertySet + IfcRelDefinesByProperties, write out.

gloss_en: Dumps the Revit IFC export category-to-IFC-class mapping table (walls->IfcWall, pipes->IfcPipeSegment, many annotation categories unmapped).
title_original: revit导出ifc对应类型
question_paraphrase: Revit导出IFC时各类别对应哪个IFC类，贴出导出图层/类别映射文件
phrasing_notes: almost no prose, raw table paste, title is a bare noun phrase
answer_summary: Mapping file lists Revit category/subcategory to IFC class and layer; unmapped categories do not export.

gloss_en: Walks through a single IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE in a STEP file: identity/geometry, connections, property sets; guesses at the meaning of empty $ fields.
title_original: IFC文件解析
question_paraphrase: 一堵墙的IFC文本里，哪些行是构件本身、哪些是连接关系、哪些是属性集；空的$字段应该是描述或类型吧
phrasing_notes: hedged ('应该是'), learner notes, defers geometry/coordinates to later posts
answer_summary: Explains entity lines, IfcRelConnects and IfcPropertySet relations by reading raw STEP.

gloss_en: Introduces Xbim.GLTF: converts IFC to glTF dropping non-geometry data; sample file shrinks 2269KB to 989KB but a tiny sample grew.
title_original: Xbim.GLTF源码解析（一）：简介
question_paraphrase: IFC里有大量非几何信息，viewer用不上；用xbim读到内存再整理几何输出成gltf，文件能小一半，但不保证每个都变小
answer_summary: Extract geometry with Xbim.Essentials and write glTF; properties are lost and must be kept separately.

gloss_en: Gitee project: IFC lightweighting tool producing files for the BIMI WebGL engine; Windows exe, no licence stated.
title_original: BIMer/IFC-Export: IFC文件轻量化处理工具
question_paraphrase: IFC轻量化处理工具，产物给BIMI引擎加载交互，需要.NET Core 2.2 和 .NET Framework 4.7
answer_summary: Domestic open-source lightweight engine chain; tied to a proprietary engine.

gloss_en: Test log dumping all properties of one IfcSlab named with Revit family:type:id, with thickness, area, volume, top/bottom elevation (mm).

answer_summary: Shows that Revit IFC export names are Family:Type:ElementId and quantities come in model units (mm).

gloss_en: Print the project/site/building/storey/space hierarchy recursively with xBIM, using IsDecomposedBy and ContainsElements.

answer_summary: Aggregation for hierarchy, containment for elements inside a storey/space.

gloss_en: Asks which Chinese encoding IfcOpenShell uses when generating IFC; UTF-8 still gives mojibake.
title_original: Chinese encode in IFC
question_paraphrase: hello, which Chinese encoding pattern do you use in IFC generation? I tried utf-8 but still messy code
phrasing_notes: short polite English from a Chinese-speaking user, little context
answer_summary: STEP encodes Unicode with \X2\ escapes; IfcOpenShell supports it; output XML as UTF-8 works; compile settings may matter.

gloss_en: GetLine() returns wrong Chinese text for \X2\7d20586b571f\X0\ lowercase hex; uppercase hex decodes correctly; a commenter pinpoints missing a-f in getNextHex.
title_original: [Bug]: The GetLine() API method has an error in parsing Chinese
question_paraphrase: IFCPROPERTYSINGLEVALUE里的\X2\...\X0\小写十六进制，GetLine读出来是错的，改成大写就对
phrasing_notes: bug report template, concrete STEP line pasted
answer_summary: Lowercase hex in \X2\ escape not handled in string_parsing.cpp; fix by accepting a-f.

gloss_en: Strings with Chinese/Cyrillic characters get truncated when reading an ifcXML file with IfcOpenShell.
title_original: Wrong string value parsed from the file
question_paraphrase: ifcxml里Name含中文或西里尔字符，读出来被截断，非拉丁字符成了字符串起点
answer_summary: Open bug on non-ASCII handling in ifcXML parsing.

answer_summary: Open issue; typical causes are missing geometry representations or unsupported export settings.

gloss_en: Python code to generate glTF from an IFC model with IfcOpenShell geometry.

question_paraphrase: 用ifcopenshell.geom把每个构件的顶点面取出来，自己拼成gltf

gloss_en: Parse IFC and generate glTF from Java (via IfcOpenShell bindings).

gloss_en: Extract the coordinates of IFC elements with XBIM.

expected_behavior: Iterate IfcWall, use get_psets, export CSV with requested columns, report walls lacking the pset.

expected_behavior: Scan Name/ObjectType/property string values for \X2\ escapes, decode UTF-16 hex, list results, note whether the library already decodes and whether lowercase hex is a trigger.

gloss_en: Convert to glb for web, keep GlobalId on each mesh
prompt: 帮我把这个ifc转成glb给前端用，每个mesh要带GlobalId，不然属性对不上，按楼层拆开最好
expected_behavior: Export geometry to glb, map each mesh to GlobalId (extras/node names), split by IfcBuildingStorey, produce metadata json, warn about lost properties.

expected_behavior: Read mapping, find elements by GlobalId, create pset and property, save new file, list unmatched ids.

expected_behavior: Report IfcSite RefLatitude/RefLongitude/RefElevation, IfcMapConversion/CRS, True North, else explain manual origin.
